sales_by_region.sql: SELECT region, category, product, amount, profit, order_date FROM sales WHERE order_date >= :from::date AND order_date <= :to::date ORDER BY region NULLS LAST, category NULLS LAST, product, id

ops_by_day.sql: SELECT day, service, team, requests, failures, avg_ms FROM ops WHERE day >= :from::date AND day <= :to::date ORDER BY day, service

finance_by_period.sql: SELECT period, cost_center, account, plan_amount, fact_amount FROM finance WHERE period >= :from::date AND period <= :to::date ORDER BY period, cost_center NULLS LAST, account

slow_probe.sql: SELECT pg_sleep(:seconds::int) IS NULL AS done

sales_by_region_id.sql: SELECT s.region, s.category, s.product, s.amount, s.profit, s.order_date FROM sales s WHERE s.region_id = :region::int AND (:category = '' OR s.category = :category) AND s.order_date >= :from::date AND s.order_date <= :to::date ORDER BY s.category NULLS LAST, s.product, s.id

sales_multi_filter.sql: SELECT s.region, s.category, s.product, s.amount, s.profit, s.order_date FROM sales s WHERE s.region_id = :region::int AND (:category = '' OR s.category = ANY(string_to_array(:category, ','))) AND s.order_date >= :from::date AND s.order_date <= :to::date AND (:scope = 'all' OR s.profit > 0) ORDER BY s.category NULLS LAST, s.product, s.id

finance_by_cost_center.sql: SELECT f.period, f.cost_center, f.account, f.plan_amount, f.fact_amount FROM finance f WHERE f.period >= :from::date AND f.period <= :to::date AND (:cost_center = '' OR f.cost_center = :cost_center) ORDER BY f.period, f.account, f.id

ops_by_service.sql: SELECT o.day, o.service, o.team, o.requests, o.failures, o.avg_ms FROM ops o WHERE o.day >= :from::date AND o.day <= :to::date AND (:service = '' OR o.service = :service) ORDER BY o.day, o.service, o.id
